espocrm-0.description: EspoCRM is an open-source web application designed to build loyal relationships with customers and boost your sales. The software creates a unified collaborative place for your employees with all the necessary data inside - customer profiles and communications with them, information about opportunities, sales orders, invoices & quotes. It allows to streamline the sales processes, automate routine operations, create personalized marketing campaigns and provide top quality customer service.

product-videos-woocommerce.description: Instantly Find and Embed Videos for all the products you sell, from all the major media websites including YouTube, Facebook and Vimeo. Display embedded media as the Product Featured Video or in a custom tab. You can automate the entire process and you have detailed control over which videos show on which products. Get Started for Free!

voice-apps.description: Here any one can develop voice apps for Amazon Echo, Google Assistant and Microsoft Cortana. We support proactive event notifications using scheduler and web hooks. Users can also develop Chatbots using NLP.

poluxfr.description: Polux.fr is a site about dogs. Animated by enthusiasts, our advice will allow you to (better) love your companion on all fours! The site uses Dog CEO's API to feature a random breed of dog each day, on the Polux.fr under the image of the day.

dynamic-insights.description: The Dynamic Insights platform by Zrillo pulls data from small business apps to give accountants, advisors, franchises and small business owners to give them a complete picture of a business via dashboards with over 60 widgets.

virtual-classroom-api-integration.description: Virtual Classroom API offers integration with any LMS or CMS such as WordPress, Drupal and Moodle. Virtual Classroom APIs allow seamless integration across technologies so an integration using technologies like aSP.net, PHP, Node.Js websites or any standard CMS and LMS platform can be undertaken. While most open source Learning Management Systems (LMS) like Moodle offer all functionality required to deliver asynchronous or self paced courses, there is no good ready to use open source or free solution available for delivering instructor led live classes. While Big Blue Button (BBB) and Free Conference Call offer free solution, you still need an expert eLearning development team to integrate the solution with your website or LMS. Xornor Technologies, is a team of engineers who specialize in eLearning, LMS, Virtual Classroom and API integration offering expert solutions to integrate different Virtual Classroom APIs like WizIQ classroom API, Big Blue Button Virtual Classroom, Zoom or Free conference call webinar solution to conduct live classes.

spotify-mood-music.description: This mashup (script) identifies an emotion from an image with Microsoft’s Emotion API, then recommends a musical playlist based on the emotion identified using Spotify's Public API.

trip-republic.description: Trip Republic is a travel planner, integrating 3rd party supply with user content to create a unique suggestions application. Plan & share trip ideas with co-travelers Search & book flights, hotels, activities, restaurants, etc., Personalized travel recommendations from your travel buddy.

synesica.description: Synesica offers fragrance recommendations based on different attributes such as aquatic, spicy, and citric. Additionally, users can take a lifestyle test to obtain a list of recommendations. This Mashup uses the ScentSee API which is a perfume index service that compiles expert opinions, and customer reviews.

open-data-companion-odc.description: The Open Data Companion (ODC) app for Android provides a unified access point to over 170 open data portals and thousands of datasets from around the world; right from your mobile device. Crafted with mobile-optimized features and design, it is is an easy and convenient way to find, access and share open data. Open Data Companion provides a framework for all Private Sector, State, Regional, National and Worldwide open data portals to deliver open data to all mobile users. FEATURES: Browse datasets from over 170 data portals around the world by categories Download and view data records (resources) on your mobile device Preview dataset records and create data visualisations in app before download (as supported by the portal) Translate dataset details from various languages to your preferred language (as determined by user’s Google Account settings) Bookmark/save datasets for later viewing Favorite your data portals for future easy access Sync your app data (bookmarks, Favorite & settings) securely to your Google Drive and restore it to any device at anytime Share links to datasets on social media, email, sms, etc. right from the app In-app tutorial videos designed to help you quickly get productive with the app. Tutorial videos are available offline once downloaded

kissmetrics-shopify.description: Kissmetrics is a solution for customer analytics and this integration is an easy and cost-effective way to integrate. This app works automatically with Multipass, and integrates the Just Uno and Recharge 3rd party services, and is easy to customize.

findilike.description: FindiLike Hotel Search is a hotel search and review analysis system that helps users find hotels based on their reviews, prices, or location. Hotels can be searched with unstructured keywords like, pet friendly, swimming pool, or friendly staff. SmartCommunicator works across multiple platforms.

It helps photographers to determine when and where to capture their images.

youturn.description: Similar to Hyperlapse, YouTurn allows users to capture video at specific frame rates ranging from one to five frames per second. This way, users are able to take videos of their drives or road-trips to relive and to share their moments with others. The application compresses the video to decrease file size, making it fast and easy for others to access.

Content on Izik is presented in various categories to allow for minimal typing and to provide context to results. youtube-vision.description: See who is uploading what and from where on YouTube.

southwind-fan-and-light.description: A retailer of ceiling fans and lighting products uses FedEx and UPS to track packages, as well as Authorize.Net customer information management.

wectar.description: The idea of wectar is the fusion of two worlds, dmoz.org and del.icio.us. It combines these two rich ingredients by relating web pages to it according to a home brewed algorithm well-fed with del.icio.us tag information. Bone Appetit.

boston-universities-map.description: Map of Boston colleges and universities.

last.fm-music-map.description: Discover music events and concerts around the world. The Last.fm Music Map mixes Last.fm music social network data with Google Maps.

chromial.description: Online map of properties entering foreclosure across the U.S. by metro area.

twittermonkey.description: Twitter XMPP mashup in Rails that adds tweets that are tracked via Jabber using a bot to a database. An experiment that is part of a larger project.

svraka.description: Paragliding pictures and videos from Croatia, archived by date.

spielpl%C3%A4tze-f%C3%BCr-klein-und-gro%.description: Map for locating all kinds of playgrounds in Germany.

afrous-mashup-builder.description: A JavaScript-based mashup engine that runs entirely on your web browser. No software installation, no server hosting. Numerous web services are now available and mashable under this JavaScript engine.

us-taxpayer-contribution-to-iraq-war.description: Mashup that combines data from the Nation Priorities Project and Google Maps to show how many billions taxpayers in each US state are paying. And where that money might otherwise be spent.

happytwitter.description: This service displays contributed messages and contributor images from Twitter. It is possible to search by keyword, such as happy, sad, or interesting.

learnit-lists.description: This mashup has now been replaced with our new rebranded version, you can find it at www.learn10.com

virtual-earth-mac-widget.description: Mapping, search, and location functions in a handy OS X Tiger Dashboard widget.

beanatomics-traffic.description: Links the traffic information from the Yahoo Traffic site and places the locations on a Virtual Earth map.

distance-calculator.description: You can use the Google Maps Distance Calculator to find out the distance between two or more points anywhere on the earth.

photo-feed-slideshow-wigdet.description: The gadget lets the users turn their RSS album of latest albums, all albums and others into an always updated photo slideshow. They can paste the code into their other web presence like their blog, or any social website they have.

packmapr.description: USPS, UPS, and FedEx package mapping Internet tool. Also offers RSS subscription to individual package progress and average speed between each point on a package's path.

imusix.description: Mashup that aggregates music videos from YouTube with a search interface.

windfinder-conncted-to-wind.description: The Windfinder iGoogle Gadget is a tiny piece of software, which displays wind, waves and weather from your favorite surfspot as observations and forecast.

nba-above.description: NBA basketball teams on the map. Click on team icon to get latest news. Now it's also possible to view NBA players' location as it's set in their twitter profiles, as well as their latest tweets

custom-igoogle-skins-v2.description: This new version of the skins gadget integrates Flickr and iGoogle to being you random images from a user specified Flickr group.

lyrics-and-clips.description: Collection of songs and video clips with their lyrics.

online-encyclopedia.description: Searches Encarta, Wikipedia, Britannica and others using Google Custom Search.

amazon-shopping-mashup.description: Amazon shopping mashup built using amazon eCommerce widgets.

twitterposter.description: Large interactive poster of photos of Twitter users, sized to their influence on Twitter.

meteosun.description: MeteoSun is a weather forecast mashup with Google Maps and The Weather Channel.

silverlight-photo-carousel.description: A Silverlight 1.0-based photo carousel displaying interesting photos from Flickr. The application was implemented in Script#.

byownerport.com.description: This is a mashup of craigslist and Google Maps. People can sell, rent, find houses or find roommates. Instead of entering a zip code, you actually fly there, and focus on the area you want to live in from a birds eye view..

geopix-fractal-view.description: The fractal view of GeoPix shows a fractal tiled structure over an interactive map. The user controls the point of view and the scale using the map, and the system fills the tiles in the fractal view with the appropriate images.

do-my-sport.description: Virtual Earth Mashup to help find sports location and event in your area. You can find out about the sports you are interested in and event arrange a meeting of your own at your favourite location. Make new friends who do the same sports as you.

placespotting.description: Play a game based on Google Maps. You can create riddles and try to solve riddles created by other people. You get a picture of a place somewhere on Earth and have to find this place.

onair-air-app.description: A mash-up of the Adobe OnAIR Bus Tour data from onair.adobe.com with this downloadable AIR application.

find-garage-sales-map.description: Find garage sales, local estate sales, multi-family yard sales in your area by looking at a map. Plan your trip here by comparing garage sales by location.

taxiwiz.description: Get the fare before you ride. This mashup calculates the approximate fare for taxi rides between two addresses. It uses Google Maps to plot and calculate the driving distance between two points and uses that information to calculate the fare.

jagbox.description: Upload a file to Amazon S3 and share the link to that file with others. Recipients of the link can access and download the User File by clicking on the link.

superpages.description: Web-based version of the SuperPages. Uses Virtual Earth mapping technology to find businesses and services in your area. Driving directions, hours, and more are provided. Good wifi finder.

abramex.description: This service uses Yahoo and other tools to come up with suggestions using meta-data to make documents easier to find.

bestperf.description: A Web 2.0 site for people to track their sports records, beat chronos, challenge friends and discover new routes.

map-runner.description: Map Runner is a collection of runners routes, created by users.

turtilla-rss-mashup-tool.description: Turtilla is an online service which allows you to search and filter content related to your interests. This content is captured from a large variety of sources. The generated results can be converted to an RSS feed.

business-baseball-google-maps.description: Google Maps Mashup of Forbes data on the Most valuable teams in MLB. Also includes Yahoo Sports MLB RSS feeds.

alertnet.description: Display crisis hotspots on a world map and retrieve latest news on each crisis from Reuters.

world-nirvana.description: Dynamic tribute to Kurt Cobain, showing Nirvana live concerts on a Google map by year. Search for videos directly by keywords.

cyberandorra.description: Find Andorra hotels directly on a map, with photos and information.

hipoqih.com.description: hipoqih.com is a system composed of a Web and plugin for mobile devices that allow recording warnings and URL associated to any geopoint in the planet. These warnings can be show automatically in terminals with the plugin when approaching that geopoint.

productdose.description: Online shopping site for men built using the shopping.com API.

sofatube.description: SofaTube is a specially designed web application that lets you browse and watch videos from YouTube and Revver in your living room where viewers are usually sitting far away from their standard or high definition television.

stumblevideo.description: The terrific StumbleUpon service adds the ability for users to select, rate and discover videos from YouTube, Google Video and MySpace.

bank-anywhere.com.description: Combines FDIC Bank branch data with Google Maps. Includes flexible search by zip, city and address.

slippymap.description: Example of how to search by address to find points of interest in your area based on Where2GetIt that requires no javascript.

political-turkeys-year.description: A look at Political Turkeys as reported by CNN.

boddit.description: Offers price comparison for online deals. It aggregates deals from a variety of bargain hunting websites into a slick price comparison engine.

outdoorphotoop.description: A community-based website for finding and sharing outdoor photography locations such as landscapes, panoramas, wildlife, wildflowers, waterfalls, cityscapes, canyons, and others.

top-10-paid-women.description: Map of the Top 10 paid women as reported by Fortune Magazine.

global-weather-service.description: Dagbladet.no uses Google Maps, global geocoding, ajax and global geocoded weather forecast for this experimental weather service.

gis-jobs-map.description: GIS Jobs Clearinghouse and Google Maps comes together in GIS Jobs Listing Map. This map was developed by terra IMS in collaboration with the GIS Jobs Clearinghouse. Terra IMS geocodes job listings and displays them on a Google Map.

boomtrek.description: Local search resource for travellers. Enter your location and type of business or address. Covers wide variety of locations.

educationsearch.net.description: An education search tool which enables you to search by: Location, Career, Industry/Salary and provides personalized searches to save for future reference. Utilizes Flickr, Google Maps and YouTube.

neave.tv.description: A mash-up of the most creative videos found on Google Video, YouTube, Blip.tv and other video sharing sites.

postal-code-mapper.description: Maps postal codes to geographical coordinates and shows them on a map.

nfl-fan-mapping-site.description: Create and share maps to places near your favorite NFL stadium, including tailgates, restaurants, clubs, and seats.

missing-kids-map.description: A mashup using data from the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children.

skatespots.net.description: An simple, open skatespot database with searchable entries and locations plotted on Google maps.

mapcruncher.description: Very interesting mashup technique from Microsoft Research, MSR. Shows how any type of map image data can be layered on top of a Virtual Earth map. This example with bike trail maps.

eventsites.description: Eventsites allows users to create a mini-website for their event complete with description, a Google Map and photos from Flickr. Eventsites is unusual as a mashup in that the entire site is built using only AJAX and it stores no data of its own.

virtual-tourism.description: Google Maps and Google Video mashup. Select tourist sites from around the world on Google maps and see a video of the location.

color-fields-colr-pickr.description: Great way to find Flickr photos by color. Select colors diretly or use the slider to adjust lightness and darkness. By Jim Bumgardner.

mysic.com.description: A shopping service that gives a unique view into the Amazon catalog: Line charts show you price and sales rank over time.

pacific-northwest-venture-map.description: Map of Pacific Northwest venture capital funding including Seattle, Portland, etc.

jabber-google-map.description: Shows the positions and status of Jabber - GTalk users and allows personal places to be marked and commented.

waterloo-student-housing-map.description: Waterloo Student Housing to help college and university students find rental housing and sublets. Combines UW housing database with Google Maps.

joemap.description: A do-it-yourself Goolge Maps site. You can create maps, upload photos, add comments and ratings. Explore maps created by other users.

googlecloud.description: Displays Google search terms in a tag cloud. Uses Yahoo Term Extraction API to group terms together. Greasemonkey script available.

fortune-100-best-companies-map.description: A Google Map showing the headquarters of the 100 best US companies to work for as ranked by Fortune Magazine. Marker popups give details on each.

seetoronto-virtual-tour.description: Take full 360 degree photo tours of popular Toronto landmarks like the Air Canada Centre, Rogers Centre, and CBC HQ. Good quality, large images.

flickrscape.description: Enter a word and watch the flickr photo stream. Click to interrupt stream and try another word.

fxfoto.description: Windows desktop application for managing photo scrapbooks. With photo service upload capabilities.

spell-flickr.description: Type a word or phrase into this fun Flickr application and it will return a set of images spelling-out that word, ransom-note style.

rentslicer.description: Rental property statistics for major metropolitan areas.

platial.description: Platial enables people to find, create and use meaningful maps of Places that matter to them.

delancey.description: This nice del.icio.us enhancement allows you to see which of your del.icio.us bookmarks are used most frequently. By DeWitt Clinton.

liveplasma.description: A visually rich application that combines the Amazon API to show the relationship between movies, bands, actors, etc. You can go straight from interacting to making purchases.

geoworldnews.description: The latest worldwide stories from the Washington Post plotted on a Google Maps satellite image.

esri-shapefile-viewer.description: Plots shapefiles on Virtual Earth maps.

los-taco-trucks-unitos.description: A Google Map for when you need to find a taco truck in Seattle.

toeat.com.description: Utilizing Google Maps + AJAX + Lots of Restaurants

del.icio.us-direc.tor.description: Ajax-style prototype for an alternative web-based rich UI for del.icio.us
